successCriteria.description: The loading branch condition in web/src/presentation/pages/DashboardPage.tsx derives solely from the explicit `loading` boolean; the sub-expression `employee === null || balances === null` (or any equivalent nullability-based test) is absent from the loading condition.

The four presentation states remain mutually exclusive and correctly reachable: error (role="alert") takes precedence and is shown when only the balances fetch rejects; empty state renders when balances resolves to []; populated renders the full breakdown; loading renders only while the fetch is in flight.

The existing Vitest suite in web/src/presentation/pages/DashboardPage.test.tsx still passes (empty case, balances-fetch error, full breakdown, and approvals-link tests), and `tsc --noEmit && vite build` succeeds.

constraints: Modify only web/src/presentation/pages/DashboardPage.tsx. Do not change the test file, shared types, date helpers, or any backend/API surface.
The loading state must be derived from the explicit `loading` boolean only — never from data nullability (`employee === null || balances === null`).
Preserve the existing error-precedence ordering: the `role="alert"` error branch must be evaluated before the loading branch.
outOfScope: No changes to the full breakdown rendering, empty-state message, error-state markup, or the `loading` boolean's set/clear lifecycle — those are already correct and only the loading condition's nullability sub-expression is in scope.
No changes to web/src/presentation/pages/DashboardPage.test.tsx, shared types, date helpers, or any backend/API/route surface.

entityInvariants.invariant: Resolves to exactly one of four mutually exclusive states — loading, error, empty, populated — where loading is determined solely by the explicit `loading` boolean, never by the nullability of the independently-fetched employee/balances data.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The loading condition must match the binding rule in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: "The loading condition must not be `employee === null || balances === null`; use an explicit `loading` boolean set false in both `.then` and `.catch`."

The `loading` boolean lifecycle must match PLAN.md Phase 1 item 3: set true before the fetch and false when the Promise.all settles in both success and failure paths, respecting the existing `cancelled` guard.
